name: codex-orchestration
description: Six-class taxonomy with artifact-aware and code-aware orchestration.

interface.longDescription: Activate Codex Orchestration in a new or already-open task with Turn Orchestration on, Use Orchestration, or Use Orchestration for this chat. Version 0.10.1 uses six outcome-based classes: READ_ONLY, STANDARD_ARTIFACT, DESIGN_ARTIFACT, SMALL_TWEAK, BIG_TWEAK, and BUILD. Non-code deliverables are separated from code changes: standard artifacts use GPT-5.6 Luna / Max with a Terra / Max supervisor, design-critical artifacts use Terra / Max for implementation and supervision, small tweaks use Luna / Max with Terra / Max supervision, big tweaks use Terra / Max with a Sol / High supervisor, and every net-new code capability uses Sol / High with a Sol / Extra High supervisor. The Terra / Max orchestrator still has one job: read the current query plus bounded conversational continuity, return the taxonomy route and a concrete reason to root, and stop. Root names every child from its actual model, starts the selected implementer first, immediately gives the read-only supervisor full context, loads artifact dependencies only after classification, performs root-only experience observations, and returns the supervisor's readable report. Only the supervisor's tool-free context-loading turn overlaps implementation; all workspace review remains checkpoint-serialized. Seven conflict-safe companion profiles preserve the taxonomy-only orchestrator, three implementation lanes, three supervisor lanes, continuity, and fixed routing.
defaultPrompt: Tell me “Turn Orchestration on” for same-chat read-only, artifact, tweak, and build routing.
